notes.title: TMNT: Empire City - Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Blood, Sweat, and Ooze - My 38-Year Journey to Empire City

In the lead-up to the launch of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City in 2026, we will provide you with insights into the game's design and production through a series of developer diaries. In the first one, Creative Director Ace St.Germain talks about his journey from fandom to game creation. Check out the link below!



👉🔗 https://www.cortopia.com/tmnt-empire-city-dev-diary-1/





Keep an eye out for Dev Diary #2 in August!
